scripts.build: npm run prebuild && webpack && npm run build:script
scripts.build:local: npm run prebuild && USE_LOCAL_SOURCES=1 webpack && npm run build:script
scripts.dev: npm run prebuild && npx cross-env dev=1 webpack --watch
scripts.dev:local: npm run prebuild && npx cross-env dev=1 USE_LOCAL_SOURCES=1 webpack --watch
scripts.bundle: rm -rf out && npm i && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.bundle:local: rm -rf out && npm i && npm run test && npm run build:local
scripts.package: npm run bundle && cp package.json LICENSE.md README.md out && cd out && npm publish --access=public && cd ..
